# Check of M0-a-16: closing check of the session's fix round s2 (lane `check/M0-a-16-close-s2`, flow flow-7, stage group S, 2026-10-11)

**Seat and machine.** Lane `check/M0-a-16-close-s2` ran under Opus 5.5 in Claude Code in a Claude Code cloud container
(Linux x64, Node v24.12.0). `tools/machine_profile.py --id` printed
`linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz:4cpu:16gib`. The seat ran on 2026-10-11 from 16:37 to about 19:35.

**Independence.** This is an implementer-side independent closing checker. It is not the item's author: the author's
lanes are `build/M0-a-16`, `-fix1` – `-fix3`, `-fix-s1` and `-fix-s2` (L-0430).

**The round.** It closes the SESSION FIX ROUND s2 (Q38; check note N-s2-2 of M0-a-02 s2, probe P4; C-0313 (5)(a)). It
was opened by the session, not by a failed check of M0-a-16.

**Method.**
* No git command was run.
* Probes and mutants ran only in this seat's own mirror `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-16/plat/`:
  * a tar copy of `plat/` at 16:38, without `node_modules`;
  * `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`, exit 0;
  * isolation: testkit's `@plat/kernel` resolves to the mirror's kernel.
  * Its `node_modules` was deleted at the end.
* The pre-round façade had to be reconstructed, because no seat may run git. It is the tree's `stamp.ts` / `kernel.ts`
  with the round's changes undone by script (`probes/mkpre.py`):
  * the version-only `stamp`, `stampWith` and `inlineStamp`;
  * no generation compare;
  * a version-only commit re-stamp;
  * no side-table stamp on the query / locate / neighbours / view / record / StretchRef doors.
* The current façade was a byte copy of the tree's, checked with `cmp` after every swap.
* Worker counts came from `tools/test_budget.py` (it printed 1).
* Timings here are informative only and are no result.

**Planning.** The probes and mutants below were planned from the brief's lines, C-0313, P4 and the code before the
author's result notes or self-check lines were read.

**Records.** Ledger row **L-0436**. Notes **14 – 15** in `checks/M0-a-16-notes.md`.

#### Q38: the evidence in full

**CP1: probe P4 reproduced (own probe, `zz-check-q38.test.ts`, mirror only).**
* Setup:
  * a framed arena and a kernel;
  * `takeSavepoint`;
  * a real `k.tx` commit (version 0 → 1);
  * `k.resolve(way:1)`;
  * `restoreSavepoint` (version 0, generation 1);
  * one more commit (version 1).
* Tree code: `assertCurrent(res, GROUND)` and `assertCurrent(res)` both throw
  `kernel: a stale slot: stamped at version 1 in restore generation 0, arena ground/0 is at version 1 in restore
  generation 1 (a savepoint was put back across committed batches since)`. This is the arena's message form.
* Pre-round code: both calls return silently (`"m1":null,"m2":null`), which is P4's fault.

**CP2: `stampWith` and inline values across generations.**
* Tree code:
  * a `stampWith({…, generation: 1})` value is current at generation 1;
  * an inline `{ key, version, generation: 1 }` value is current at generation 1;
  * an inline value with no generation is refused at generation 1 (`… in restore generation 0, … in restore generation
    1 …`);
  * after a second restore, both generation-1 values are refused (`… restore generation 1, … restore generation 2 …`).
* Pre-round code: all three calls return silently.

**CP4: every façade door.** The doors probed are:
* the commit, its value and its record;
* an in-batch writer value;
* the arena `Resolved` and the StretchRef `Resolved`;
* `index.query`, `index.pointLocate` and `geom.pointLocate`;
* `faceNeighbours`;
* the view and its `query` / `pointLocate` / `neighbours`.

Tree code:
* every value read before a restore across commits throws the generation message once one commit has brought the
  version back;
* every one read after the restore is current, including `view.faces()`;
* a second arena's view asserted against the restored arena gets the foreign-key message first;
* the second arena's generation stays 0.

Pre-round code: all 14 doors pass silently.

**CP5: random property.** 300 sequences of 14 steps each (commit, take, stack-discipline restore, and reads of resolve,
query, view, pointLocate and `stampWith`). Each step asserts every held value against an independent state counter.
* Tree code, over 29112 assertions: **0 silent stale, 0 false refusals**.
* Pre-round code: **1613 silent stale**.

**Mutants.** 22 targeted mutants were each run against NEAR (the five façade files). 21 were KILLED:
* M01 (the generation compare dropped, the brief's mutant): 4 red;
* M02 (version-only `stampNow`): 3 red;
* M03 (`stampWith` drops the generation): 1 red;
* M04 (`inlineStamp` drops it): 3 red;
* M05 (the generation always written, so the shape at generation 0 changes): 5 red;
* M06 (version-only commit re-stamp): 1 red;
* M07 (version checked before generation): 1 red;
* M08 (an absent generation read as current): 4 red;
* M09 – M17 (each side-table door stamp removed: query, `geom.pointLocate`, neighbours, view, `view.query`,
  `view.neighbours`, `view.pointLocate`, record, StretchRef): 1 red each;
* M18 (`stampOf` reads the inline stamp before the side table): 2 red;
* M19 (`stamp` not gated by `debugMode`): 2 red, the production pins;
* M20 (the generation message text changed): 4 red;
* M23 (a rejected batch re-stamped current): 2 red.

The survivor:
* **M22** (`batchValue` stamps an in-batch value version-only) SURVIVES.
* It is not equivalent: under M22, an op result asserted inside a batch after a cross-commit restore throws, while the
  tree passes it (CONFIRMED, probe `zz-inbatch.test.ts`).
* It is not one of the round's stated lines: C-0317 (2) lists the doors it stamps, and the in-batch value is not among
  them.
* The tree's behaviour is right, and the mutant fails loud (debug only, healed at the commit).
* So it is a further hardening test: **note 14**.

**Existing tests.** Every existing façade test is green on the tree: 5 files, 90/90.

#### Zero shift: the evidence

**Dump probe.** Own probe `zz-zero-shift.test.ts`. It dumps every façade answer's own fields across two arenas:
* the view and its faces / rings / owner / query / pointLocate / neighbours;
* resolve, and resolve of a StretchRef;
* query, both pointLocate doors, faceNeighbours and signature;
* the second arena's view;
* the content print;
* a commit with its in-batch value, and a rejected batch;
* the same set again after a cross-commit restore and one more commit.

**Results, pre-round code against tree code:**

| run | value fields | stamp shapes |
|---|---|---|
| debug off, no restore | identical (33 entries, 7711 bytes) | — |
| debug off, with restore | identical (64 entries, 14390 bytes) | — |
| debug on, no restore | identical | identical (generation 0 keeps its shape) |
| debug on, with restore | identical | differ in 19 entries |

* The 19 differing stamp shapes are exactly the post-restore stamps, which gain `generation: 1` (the intended
  debug-only change).
* On the tree, debug off and debug on give identical values.

**Production pins.** M19 is killed by the production pins.
